profile.name: Your Name
profile.bio: I'm a video editor with a love for rhythm, pacing, and the kind of cut you feel before you notice it. From punchy short-form content to cinematic brand films, I shape raw footage into stories that hold attention from the first frame to the last. I live in the timeline — color, sound design, motion graphics, and that one perfect transition.

experience.description: Lead editor for brand campaigns and long-form documentaries. Built the post-production pipeline and mentored a team of three junior editors.
highlights: Cut a documentary that crossed 4M views in its first month
Reduced average turnaround time by 35% with new proxy workflow
Established the studio's motion graphics style guide

experience.description: Edited short-form social content and product launch videos for tech and lifestyle brands.
highlights: Produced 200+ short-form videos across TikTok, Reels and Shorts
Developed reusable template packs that doubled output

experience.description: Worked directly with creators and small businesses on YouTube content, wedding films, and event recaps.
highlights: Grew a recurring roster of 15+ creator clients
Specialized in fast-paced retention-focused YouTube editing
